info.title: orbitd API
info.description: API of the Orbit daemon. Local mode listens on loopback; authenticate with the bearer token in $ORBIT_HOME/daemon.token, or (the App) with the session cookie from POST /v1/session plus the session’s X-Orbit-CSRF header (ADR-011). Hosted mode (ADR-015) serves its public https URL, signs browsers in through OIDC (cookie __Host-orbit_session) and limits each route to a least role (x-orbit-role: viewer < operator < owner); the bearer token acts as the owner.
